nodes.summary: Dispatch matrix loader reads § C3, validates skills/experts/predicates, fail-fast on any violation
Convergence engine implements parallel-then-merge, sequential-lens, structured-disagreement
Schema validator extracts YAML jsonschema from SKILL.md and validates payload; zero I/O side effects
Predicate registry: named callable registry, always_true/false built-ins, immutable after evaluate
Zero credential/network access; two allowed file-path categories only
Typed exceptions with detail + context; zero stdout/stderr writes
Loader fail-fast; validator idempotent; registry immutable after evaluate
Structured error fields on all exception types for operator diagnostic routing
N/A — headless pure-Python library with no UI surface
Dispatch matrix loader: five sub-cases — fabricated skill, fabricated expert, extension allowlist acceptance, fabricated predicate, live canonical C3 step-set
Convergence engine: three modes — block aggregate, sequential invocation order, structured-disagreement escalation count
Schema validator: raises SchemaValidationError, returns ValidationFailure, no stdout/stderr write
Predicate registry: always_true, always_false, predicate=none coercion, load-time registry miss raises DispatchMatrixError
